europe_now.title: Russian double‑tap drone strike kills 15 in Ukrainian mall
europe_now.summary: Russian forces carried out a coordinated double‑tap drone strike on a Ukrainian shopping centre, killing at least 15 civilians and prompting rescue crews to dig through the wreckage. President Zelensky condemned the attack as despicable.

europe_now.title: France pledges interceptor missiles to Ukraine amid escalating Russian strikes
europe_now.summary: France announced it will deliver interceptor missiles to Ukraine following a fresh wave of Russian strikes on civilian targets. The move is part of a broader European effort to bolster Ukraine's air defence capabilities.

top_stories.title: European diplomatic pressure mounts over Israeli settlement expansion
top_stories.summary: More than 100 senior diplomats called for action against Israeli settlement policies in the West Bank, accusing Israel of ethnic cleansing. The appeal adds to diplomatic pressure on European governments regarding the occupied territories.

top_stories.title: German airplane crashes in Croatia, killing two
top_stories.summary: A small German airplane crashed in Croatia, killing two people. The incident has raised questions about regional air traffic safety and maintenance standards.
